about: One list, two implementations: pipeline/answers.py:is_sensitive (tests/test_captures.py) and extension/shared/answers.js's isSensitive over normKey (tests/test_extension.js) must agree on which questions have their ANSWER withheld. The question itself is kept. Matching is by whole words of the normalised question, so 'languages' does not contain 'age' and 'finance' does not contain 'fin'. Nationality and work authorisation are deliberately NOT sensitive here: the visa analysis reads them. A bare 'age' is, so 'Are you at least 18 years of age?' is withheld too; that over-reach is accepted rather than carved out. Added 24 Sep 2026, when 5 stored answers turned out to be equal-opportunity questions.
cases: Are you at least 18 years of age?
Do you identify as having a disability?
Are you legally authorised to work in Singapore?
Are you a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident?
Will you now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status?
How many years of experience do you have with Python?
What is your average team size?
Have you worked in the finance industry?
Do you have experience with FinOps?
What stage of your job search are you in?
